item.title: Combiner 0.9.0
item.description:
• Weigh a project by its render, not the DAW's leftovers
  • Prints from the project start or the first sound, tails capped, Dock + ⌘-Tab
  • Live MIDI on every save (Session View too); Logic's MIDI pass first
  • A Live in another home never holds renders up
  • The render Logic always reads the arrangement
  • A kept render Logic holding other projects doesn't weigh
  • Full mix each render, and passes shared as they finish
  • Window buttons, a glow on new files, folders for drops
  • Simple Mode, a plain room to drag files in and out of
  • What the transfer speed actually is, measured
  • Pack audio for the wire, losslessly
